subject: Request: Exec approval for >20% concession on Hosted API - MedTech Labs
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Exec approval for >20% concession on Hosted API - MedTech Labs

Hi Laura / Vivek,

Quick context: MedTech Labs (healthcare device analytics) is pushing to finalize an agreement this quarter. They've asked for a 25% discount on Hosted API usage pricing for a 12-month committed term. Opportunity summary attached (redwood_proposal_v2.pdf) and HubSpot link below.

Why this matters:
- ARR: $320k committed revenue over 12 months if we accept the structure (estimated usage).
- Strategic: MedTech is running a pilot that could roll out to other lines of business in H2. Competitive pressure from Vendor X — they are offering an aggressive discount plus a data residency ask.
- Churn risk: If we don't land this they will likely choose Vendor X and we lose the upsell pipeline.

Concession requested: 25% off list Hosted API unit rates for 12 months (then revert to list). MedTech will sign a 12-month committed spend of $250k minimum and pay monthly. They want the pricing reflected in the SOW.

Asks:
1) Exec sign-off for concession >20% (25% requested).
2) If approval is conditional, please specify the constraints (term, minimums, staged concession).
3) Legal/Finance escalation path if there are non-standard contract clauses (they asked for a short data residency paragraph).

Attachments: redwood_proposal_v2.pdf
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9837452

I've included a one-page model and initial commercial terms. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Nikhil
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval for >20% concession on Hosted API - MedTech Labs

Nikhil — thanks for the summary and the attachment. A few follow-ups before I escalate to Finance/Exec: 

1) Can you provide a short margin impact calc (expected monthly usage, estimated token volume, expected gross margin % after 25%)?
2) Is the $250k minimum firm? Any flexibility on ramp or a step-down (e.g., 25% first 6 months, 10% next 6)?
3) Confirm any technical asks in the SOW beyond pricing (data residency language, custom logging). That will require Legal review.

If you can get me the margin calc and a quick note on how this concession helps expansion/retention, I'll prepare an approval memo for Vivek and Aditya.

-Laura
Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval for >20% concession on Hosted API - MedTech Labs

Laura — thanks. Attached is a compact revenue model (spreadsheet_revenue_model.xlsx) with usage assumptions. Key bullets pulled from the sheet: 

- Forecasted token consumption: ~120M tokens/month at close (month 1), average over year ~60M tokens/month.
- List ASP per 1k tokens: $0.015; 25% discount reduces to $0.01125.
- Estimated gross margin after infra and support costs at 25% discount: ~42% (we reviewed with Finance ops).
- Upsell case: If pilot converts across 2 line-of-business units they estimate +60% usage Yr2.

Concession structure proposed (options):
A) Flat 25% off list for 12 months, $250k committed minimum.
B) Tiered: 25% off first 6 months, 12% off months 7-12, $200k minimum.
C) Compromise: 22.5% (midpoint) off for 12 months with $250k minimum and a short-term pilot addendum in SOW.

Other commercial asks from MedTech: optional data residency clause (US-only logging) — lightweight language they provided; nothing that should block Legal but we should surface it.

Rationale to approve >20%:
- Immediate downside of losing the deal is high; Vendor X is already in late-stage talks.
- The committed minimum plus expected usage reduces payback period and gives runway to migrate more usage onto Redwood.
- We retain leverage for upsell and cross-sell (embeddings + fine-tune services).

I'll be available on a call if needed.

Thanks,
Nikhil
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Exec approval for >20% concession on Hosted API - MedTech Labs

Looping Aditya for visibility. Nikhil / Laura — I agree this is strategic enough to warrant >20% concession for the right structure. My conditional stance: approve a concession up to 25% provided we enforce either (A) the $250k committed minimum or (B) a tiered concession (25% then step-down) with a clear catch-up clause if usage exceeds projections.

Please produce a short memo I can sign off on that includes: precise list prices, requested discount, expected ARR, gross margin impact, and DocuSign-ready amendment language that Legal can attach. Marissa — once Laura confirms final structure, can your team prepare the DocuSign and track the deal in Salesforce / HubSpot? Deal id: DL-2026-0453.

Aditya — flagging for exec awareness. If comfortable, we'd like your high-level nod so Laura can finalize. If you want a short call, I can coordinate.

-Vivek
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: 22.5% concession (conditional) — MedTech Labs DL-2026-0453

All — after reviewing the margins and Vivek's input, Deal Desk is approving a structured concession as follows: 

Approved concession:
- Discount: 22.5% off list Hosted API usage rates for the first 12 months (this meets the >20% threshold requested).
- Commitment: $250,000 minimum committed spend over 12 months.
- Billing: monthly in arrears; early termination triggers pro-rated true-up to remove concession.
- Tier & catch-up: If monthly usage exceeds the projected 120M tokens/month by more than 30% for any two consecutive months, pricing will auto-adjust per list rates for the overage and a true-up invoice will be issued.
- Condition: Legal must clear the lightweight data residency paragraph; Finance has reviewed and is OK with the gross margin profile at approved discount.

Next steps:
1) Marissa — please prepare the DocuSign amendment and attach the approval_note_signed.pdf (this file documents the approval).
2) Nikhil — ask MedTech to sign the amendment; once signed we will mark the opportunity as closed-won in HubSpot (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9837452).
3) Laura will route the amendment to Legal to include the data residency language.

This provides the required exec-level concession (>20%) with controls. If Aditya or Vivek want a different structure, please reply by EOD.

-Laura
Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference
